test.create_query: CREATE TABLE auto_fp_reuse_build (k UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE auto_fp_reuse_probe (id UInt64, k128 UInt64, k2048 UInt64, k4096 UInt64, k8192 UInt64, k65536 UInt64, k_unique UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO auto_fp_reuse_build SELECT intHash64(number + 17), number FROM numbers(1048576)

INSERT INTO auto_fp_reuse_probe SELECT number, intHash64(1048576 + number % 128 + 17), intHash64(1048576 + number % 2048 + 17), intHash64(1048576 + number % 4096 + 17), intHash64(1048576 + number % 8192 + 17), intHash64(1048576 + number % 65536 + 17), intHash64(1048576 + number + 17) FROM numbers(16777216)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(l.id), sum(r.v) FROM auto_fp_reuse_probe AS l ALL INNER JOIN auto_fp_reuse_build AS r ON l.k128 = r.k
SELECT count(), sum(l.id), sum(r.v) FROM auto_fp_reuse_probe AS l ALL INNER JOIN auto_fp_reuse_build AS r ON l.k2048 = r.k
SELECT count(), sum(l.id), sum(r.v) FROM auto_fp_reuse_probe AS l ALL INNER JOIN auto_fp_reuse_build AS r ON l.k4096 = r.k
SELECT count(), sum(l.id), sum(r.v) FROM auto_fp_reuse_probe AS l ALL INNER JOIN auto_fp_reuse_build AS r ON l.k8192 = r.k
SELECT count(), sum(l.id), sum(r.v) FROM auto_fp_reuse_probe AS l ALL INNER JOIN auto_fp_reuse_build AS r ON l.k65536 = r.k

SELECT count(), sum(l.id), sum(r.v) FROM (SELECT id, if(id < 65536, k_unique, k128) AS k FROM auto_fp_reuse_probe ORDER BY id) AS l ALL INNER JOIN auto_fp_reuse_build AS r ON l.k = r.k SETTINGS max_threads = 1
